latest_release.body:
Secretive 4 is here with big improvements in stacked requests, request usage attribution, first class SSH Certificate support, and support for macOS 27.

## Features
- macOS 27 Support
- OpenSSH protocol cleanup (#775)
- LAContext persistence for smart cards (#760)
- SSH Certificate UI (#798, #802)
- OpenSSH extensions support (#823)
- Support for looking up hosts from `known_hosts` file (#826)
- Secure settings storage (#831)
- Pending requests UI (#821)

## Fixes
- Fix macOS 27 UI issues (#814, #774)
- Fix context menu display on macOS 14 (#774)
- Various CI and config fixes (#767, #773, #807, #781, #833, #793, #824, #801, #768, #822, #800, #806, #783, #837, #829, #828)
- Fix SSH ECDSA signature mpint encoding (#772)
- Fix race condition in SocketController (#769)
- Use separate socket for debug builds (#766)
- Fix internet access policy linking (#794)
- PT-BR localization fixes (#804)
- Keychain fixes (#830)
- Log cleanup (#832)
- LLM usage policy (#799)

## Minimum macOS Version
15.0.0
